validity.researcher_notes: SegmentName='Capacity Expansion' (cancelled, StartYear1=2021, LengthKnownKm already correctly 0.00). This is Alliance Pipeline L.P.'s 2018-announced, ~400 MMcf/d (~25%) capacity expansion for Q4 2021 service. Pembina's own open-season release (PRNewswire, 2018-03-28) states the expansion is 'through the addition of compression and other facilities' -- no looping or new pipe mentioned. Independently, Enbridge Inc.'s FY2017 Form 10-K (filed 2018, a DIFFERENT registrant from Pembina/Alliance, so this is a genuinely second origin) separately describes the same project: 'Alliance Pipeline continues to engage with interested parties and assess the addition of more compression facilities along the system in order to increase throughput capacity... The projected in-service date for the potential capacity expansion is the second half of 2021.' Two independent companies both describe this specifically as a COMPRESSION project, consistent with the wiki's own '20 in' figure being the existing MAINLINE diameter (not a diameter for this expansion project) and with the sheet's LengthKnownKm=0 already being correct. Per the compression-only-expansion rule (CLAUDE.md / gem_schema.md), a blank Diameter here is the correct value, not a gap -- confirming it is the output. The open season fell short of its 400 MMcf/d target by the May 2018 close and the project did not proceed (consistent with the sheet's Status=cancelled, which is not itself a flag in this brief).
